actions_or_findings.title: 1. Implement official credential authentication and draft migration 0009
actions_or_findings.trigger: Current authentication supports only Development and WeChat JWTs; SMS/password/session revocation are absent, and unknown WeChat identities silently create Users.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Draft revision 20260919_0009 with down_revision=20260917_0007; do not modify 0001-0007, occupy 0008, or apply it to any persistent database. Add User.profile_completed_at, user_phones with verified history and phone uniqueness, user_passwords with one Argon2id credential per User, sms_challenges with keyed code hash/TTL/attempts/consumed_at, and auth_sessions with hashed rotating refresh tokens, auth_method, expiry, and revocation. Implement atomic Redis send/login throttles through an injectable limiter that fails closed; unit tests must use a fake and must not touch Redis. OTPs must be random per challenge, one-time, retry-limited, never returned by formal APIs, and never logged; the Development SMS provider must be explicitly labeled and test-capturable without becoming real-SMS evidence. Implement /auth/sms/send, /auth/sms/login, /auth/password/login, /auth/password/change, /auth/password/reset, /auth/token/refresh, and /auth/logout across model/identity.py, schema/auth.py, service/auth.py or a focused credential_auth.py, repository/identity.py, provider/sms, provider/factory.py, core/security.py, core/config.py, and core/errors.py. OTP login may create one User only after phone proof and uniqueness locking; password login never creates one. Formal JWTs use auth_method sms|password, a server-checked session identifier, and current database authorization; password reset/change revoke all old sessions and issue a fresh session only after successful verification. Known WeChat bindings may receive session-backed auth_method=wechat tokens; an unknown openid must return bind-required without inserting User/UserWechat, then bind only after an authenticated phone/password session exchanges a fresh WeChat code. Conflicts require later controlled merge, never auto-merge. Update the mini-program login flow to real SMS/password actions, validated /me restoration and refresh rotation; keep Seed login only under explicit LOCAL_PREVIEW and ensure no formal handler calls /auth/dev/token. Router mounting and token verification must independently reject Development Auth outside development/test. If reserved 0008 lands before migration approval, retarget 0009 to revise 0008; otherwise 0008 must later revise 0009—never create sibling heads.

actions_or_findings.title: 2. Add safe house catalog APIs and remove raw house_id from the formal UI
actions_or_findings.trigger: PropertyRepository contains hierarchy queries, but no catalog HTTP routes exist and the current mini-program bind form requires a typed house_id.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Add authenticated GET /properties, /properties/{id}/buildings, /buildings/{id}/units, and /units/{id}/houses using repository/service methods that derive tenant/property ancestry from stored parents rather than trusting client scope. Return only safe physical catalog fields, filter inactive Tenant/House records, and never join or expose resident names, phones, relationships, bind requests, or work orders. Add PATCH /me/profile for display_name and profile completion. Rework pages/houses into cascading property/building/unit/room selectors; the selected internal house ID may be submitted to the unchanged POST /resident-bind-requests API, but no formal text input may accept house_id. Preserve existing manager approve/reject APIs. Tests must prove unauthenticated denial, parent-scope validation, absence of resident data, pending bind state, and that catalog visibility does not authorize work-order creation or resident resources before approval.

actions_or_findings.title: 3. Bind an authenticated User to an existing Employee through a controlled claim
actions_or_findings.trigger: POST /admin/employees currently requires client-supplied user_id; no invite or ownership-verification flow exists.
actions_or_findings.rationale: In 0009 make employees.user_id nullable while retaining the unique FK for claimed employees; existing non-null records remain unchanged. Add employee_invites with BIGINT identity, employee/tenant scope, target phone, hashed random claim token, inviter, expiry, retry/status, claimant, consumed_at, and uniqueness for one active invite per Employee. Permit administrators with current employee:manage scope to create an unbound Employee and separately issue/revoke/resend its invite; keep direct user attachment only in internal Development fixtures. The authenticated claim endpoint must lock invite and Employee, require an active verified UserPhone matching the target, reject expiry/replay/disabled Employee/duplicate binding, and set employee.user_id exactly once. Resolve Role by code STAFF and grant only scopes derived from current EmployeeProperty rows in the same transaction; never accept user_id, role, tenant/property scope, or employee_no as claim authority. Add a mini-program employee-claim page accepting only the opaque invitation. Tests must cover a different authenticated User, employee_no-only input, disabled Employee, expired/replayed invite, duplicate claim, cross-tenant manager, and permission revocation affecting an already-issued session.

actions_or_findings.title: 4. Wire deterministic auto-assignment behind ai_auto_assign
actions_or_findings.trigger: AnalysisService writes deterministic recommendations but always stops at PENDING_ASSIGNMENT; WorkOrderAssignment currently requires a human assigned_by_user_id.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Extend 0009 to backfill work_order_assignments.assigned_source=HUMAN, make assigned_by_user_id nullable, add payload_json, and enforce HUMAN requires an actor while AUTO requires assigned_by_user_id NULL. Update response schemas accordingly. Also add ai_call_logs.provider_mode with DEVELOPMENT|PRODUCTION and backfill current rows DEVELOPMENT so Fake and real evidence cannot be mixed. When settings.ai_auto_assign is true, call a transactional auto-dispatch service after validated, non-low-confidence, non-high-risk analysis and recommendation generation. It must lock the WorkOrder and selected EmployeeDailyStatus, re-run active User/STAFF role, Employee, EmployeeProperty, duty/skill, on-duty, property and capacity checks, then atomically create the AUTO Assignment, increment load, set current_assignment_id, transition to ASSIGNED, and write SYSTEM WorkOrderLog/AuditLog entries with actor_user_id NULL and the analysis/rank/score/filter snapshot. It must never consume employee_id from LLM output. Disabled setting, low confidence, non-none risk, provider failure, invalid output, no candidate, revoked/disabled employee, or concurrency conflict must retain the appropriate PENDING_ANALYSIS or PENDING_ASSIGNMENT human queue with an explicit reason. Preserve human assign/reassign as HUMAN. Keep ai_auto_assign=False in persistent configuration and add no outbox/claim table; document the future outbox transaction boundary in the schema review.

actions_or_findings.title: 5. Add negative-path tests and evidence boundaries
actions_or_findings.trigger: Historical VIS and Development-provider results do not prove official authentication, automatic Assignment creation, or real AI.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Add focused unit/static tests runnable without external state and DB-backed integration tests staged for later disposable-DB approval. Required cases: wrong password; wrong, expired, exhausted, and replayed OTP; SMS limits; Argon2id storage; refresh replay; password reset/change session revocation; unknown WeChat causing no User side effect; unauthorized identity switching; production DevAuth route and existing-token rejection; catalog data minimization; unapproved house access; disabled Employee; live permission revocation; default-off auto-dispatch; enabled safe-result auto-dispatch creating WorkOrderAssignment without the human assign endpoint; no-candidate/high-risk/low-confidence/provider-failure fallbacks; concurrent assignment/capacity behavior; and rejection of an LLM employee_id field. Provider evidence must show mode, provider/model identity, validated structured output and downstream state; adapter construction, HTTP 200, ANALYZE, or citations alone are insufficient. Record exact commands, SHA, passed/failed/skipped counts and environment classification in software-test-results.json. Keep live-provider-results.json as NOT_RUN until credentials and authorization exist. Migration upgrade/downgrade and runtime integration tests must wait for an explicitly approved disposable database and must never target property_ai/property_ai_day4 or recreate mysql-test.
